title: An Exact Operator Formulation of Statistical Quasiparticle Theory for Nonlinear System-Bath Coupling
summary: We develop an operator formulation of statistical quasiparticle theory for open quantum systems with nonlinear system-bath coupling, extending beyond the linear coupling setting of the standard Gaussian influence functional formulation. For Gaussian baths, the statistical quasiparticles, termed dissipatons, are explicitly constructed as collective operators in the thermofield bath space. Our construction provides a microscopic operator basis for the dissipaton algebra and generates hierarchical equations of motion directly from the Liouville equation.
